scope: Eight proposed recording briefs based on existing KB stories; no outreach or audio acquired.

items.purpose: Welcome in a named household or community
items.questions: Ask when this voice is welcome here, who may make it, and which occasions should not be recorded.
items.desired_capture: A short vocal demonstration and a spoken explanation, only if the contributor wants both.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.

items.purpose: A single conch and a named ensemble
items.questions: Ask the player to name the instrument and explain one phrase; distinguish a demonstration from a procession.
items.desired_capture: One conch phrase followed by a separately captioned ensemble excerpt.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.

items.purpose: A player explains one rhythmic phrase
items.questions: Ask for the phrase name, learning credit and how it relates to a dancer or singer; avoid presenting it as a whole curriculum.
items.desired_capture: Demonstration, pause, then an explanation in the player’s chosen language.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.

items.purpose: A song in its specific occasion
items.questions: Ask for community, place, occasion, song version and credited singers; establish whether words may be transcribed and translated.
items.desired_capture: A short permitted phrase with a contextual explanation; no generic substitute soundtrack.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.

items.questions: Ask the artists to identify their roles and the text being narrated, and explain where the response changes the story.
items.desired_capture: A short exchange with both voices credited and the text/version identified.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.

items.questions: Ask for the local object name, maker credit and how the sound is produced; obtain permission separately for a workshop and a ritual.
items.desired_capture: An object demonstration with a close explanation of what was sounded.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.

items.questions: Ask for the work, author, edition or oral version, roles and accompanying artists; clear underlying text rights as well as recording rights.
items.desired_capture: A short explained passage, with an accessible summary and authorised transcript if available.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.

items.questions: Ask the hosts for local dance/song names, community, occasion and musicians; a public-stage permission does not cover a village ceremony.
items.desired_capture: A short group passage with musicians and dancers credited as they prefer.
limitations: Desk brief only; no contributor, venue, recording or permission secured.
